data.description:
Get closer to the **Premier League** like never before with Premier League Player, the first-ever officially licensed VR Football (Soccer) game.

**Featuring all 20 Premier League teams**, authentic stadiums, and official kits.
![{"height":328,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982637_1256086788975407_8536752705492703649_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dUm6RFLZGeQQ7kNvgGyZUFq&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAljWpKR-pDWjVzwdpat_7OeEsnZhVq-5AQgZAnXtZNGA&oe=678CCA63)

# Moments
Step into the action with **Moments mode**, where you can replay highlights from the 2023/24 season. Become a hero for the club you support by scoring game-winning goals, delivering pinpoint assists, and feeling the intensity of every moment as if you were on the field.
{496176953457265}

# Shot Stopper
As the last line of defence, test your reflexes as a Premier League goalkeeper in our **Shot Stopper mode**.
{1115537873623924}

# Headers
Rise above the competition in our **Heading mode**, perfecting the art of accuracy and timing. Jump in solo or with friends in head-to-head or coop mode.
{1149444206802903}

# Free Play
Experience **Freeplay mode**, solo or with friends in local party mode, and sharpen your abilities with tailored Training Drills.
{1279307706541047}

# The Sanctuary
Explore the **Player Sanctuary** to unlock and organise players, make the space your own, and then show off with your friends. Collect achievements and celebrate your journey to becoming a **Premier League Player**.
{1107258291029645}

![{"height":300,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974693_1760176544734682_9207197001086630319_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=WBcPPpRV_RwQ7kNvgEsq0ZK&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBaiistKMBxNYGndRvevmxUSdAutWTP7-lBLRpE6ub2XQ&oe=678CE2BF)

changelog.change_log:
GAME MECHANIC UPDATE! ⚙️⚽

Version: 0.4.300

BOOTS! 
Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've adjusted the collision volume on the boots. This change gives players more control and makes it easier to chip up and volley in Freeplay.

OPEN FOOT / VOLLEY 
Based on user feedback, we’ve also made the trigger for opening the foot straighter. This adjustment makes it easier to volley and execute open-foot strikes, with no changes to side-foot passes or other mechanics.

***Pro Tip: Remember, we use real-world physics! If you lean back when shooting, the ball will naturally go higher. To keep your shots low, make sure to keep your head over the ball.
Happy playing!

**Version 0.4.294 Update Notes**

We have made some updates. Will be live shortly.
Moving forward we are going to aim to have updates or update news every Thursday AM (GMT)!


MOMENTS
Addressed orientation reset issue during transition, fixing players turning on the spot while replaying fractions. (Stops you spinning needlessly)

FIRST BOOT NEW USERS & WARM-UP (TUTORIAL)
Warm-up (Tutorial) is now:
Shortened by 50% and takes place in your chosen club stadium, has club keeper and players.
Warmup is now mandatory to ensure a smoother transition to the kicking mechanic.
N.B You can now replay the Warm-up in freeplay at any time, just use the stadium selector in Freeplay to change the warm-up stadium anytime.

Changes to Warm-up:
Ball despawn time halved for quicker progression.
Club selected Keeper added for a more realistic experience.
Animated players warming up on the pitch, letting you see your teammates earlier.(Especially if in the trial).
Crowd ambience added for an immersive vibe.
GK difficulty Locked to Easy during the Warm-up.(To help with new players)
Emitters tweaked for better consistency and easier scanning for new players.

Freeplay Updates:
Global tweaks to GK difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard).
Easier gameplay ease in for your newbie friends during Party play!

Dive in and let us know your thoughts!

Things coming soon in the pipeline.
Some GK new levels and modes.
Some test on boot sizes.
Wander ball and movement tests.

General
Added Cloud Diagnostics and hooked up to Unity Dashboard

Fixed sizing of XP bar in all games

Updated settings on Shields to remove border pixels

Sanctuary
Update mipmapping settings and texture formats for posters

Moments
Added Voice over to Calibration in Solo and Multiplayer

Adjusted settings for timing accuracy scoring in Solo and Multiplayer

Players
Added new head model for Connor Bradley

Updated Opta Id on head for Jacob Murphy

Fixed shoulders sagging on player reveal animations

Known Issues
Floating ball in wolves game- fix for next build.

UPDATE:
We have added some hot fixes for aim assist.
We have turned off all aim assist for HARD- so this is pure prem player level.
EASY and MEDIUM both have had tweaks to values to accommodate the performance improvements.
Enjoy  and thankyou to the Player feedback.

General Improvements:
- ADDRESSED FRAMERATE DROP AFFECTING PHYSICS AND GAMEPLAY BALL PING OFF'S
- Improved messaging for unlocks and clarified Silver score requirements to access more Moments levels.
- Added shadows under the ball for better visuals.
- Banter board optimized. (Multiplayer Moments)
- Smoother ball movement and rotation (GLOBAL)

Calibration Update:
- Calibration circles offset removed in Moments Multiplayer. Now, all players calibrate in the centre of the pitch!

Player Head Updates:
- Freshened up player heads in Moments and on plinths in the main menu.

Score Messaging:
- Main menu now shows Bronze, Silver, and Gold score requirements for each Moment.
- Post-Moment UI updated to better indicate your achievements and areas for improvement.

Fixes for Moments Multiplayer:
- Aerial target issues resolved.
- Performance in MP moments improved.

*We are also continuing work on Quest 2 regarding framerate but its a tough task given how much is going on with regard to the physics and animation, but users should see a significant improvement from last week. Stay tuned for further Quest 2 updates.*

**Quest 2 casting while playing the game causes framing issues- Avoid**
